mapper.select:
select qb.qc_status as type, count(0) as count from qc_bill qb
qb.is_deleted = false
and qb.qc_date >= #{params.dateList[0]} and (#{params.dateList[1]}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > qb.qc_date
group by qb.qc_status

select case when #{type} = 'day' then to_char(qb.qc_date::DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') when #{type} = 'week' then to_char(date::DATE-(extract(dow from qb.qc_date::TIMESTAMP)-1||'day')::interval, 'YYYY-mm-dd') when #{type} = 'month' then to_char(qb.qc_date::DATE, 'YYYY-MM') as dateStr, qb.qc_status as status, count (0) as count from qc_bill qb
qb.is_deleted = false
and qb.qc_date >= #{beginDate} and (#{endDate}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > qb.qc_date
group by dateStr, qb.qc_status
